Trains to Eastbourne

This is the train I would look at for Eastbourne Airshow. Eastbourne station is in the town centre, and Southern runs direct trains from London Victoria, Gatwick Airport, Lewes and Hastings, and from Brighton, some with a change at Lewes. From the station it’s a flat 10 to 15 minute walk to the Western Lawns. Trains are busiest on the Saturday and Sunday mornings, so I would suggest travelling early.
